documents.name: Licence Terms

documents.name: Portfolio
documents.note: 40 marks to renew at 350 each; agent fee 15%.

tasks.title: Royalty Payable
tasks.prompt: Net sales 2,000,000 at 5%, with a minimum guarantee of 120,000. What is the royalty payable?
tasks.workingNote: 5% x 2,000,000 = 100,000, below the 120,000 minimum, so 120,000 is payable.
tasks.mistake: Paying only the percentage ignores the minimum.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Renewal Budget
tasks.prompt: 40 marks at 350 each, plus a 15% agent fee. What is the total?
tasks.mistake: Missing a renewal can lose the right.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Clearance Search
tasks.prompt: Why run a clearance search before filing a trademark?
options: To find conflicting marks and reduce refusal or infringement risk
tasks.mistake: Filing without searching risks costly disputes.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Strong Marks
options: Arbitrary word used unrelated to the goods
tasks.reasoning: Distinctive marks are easier to protect.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Royalty Statement (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Royalty in column D = net sales x rate % / 100.
tasks.tip: Check each rate against its contract.
tasks.mistake: Applying one rate to all licensees misstates income.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Reply to Complaint
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence reply to an infringement complaint that does not admit liability.
tasks.modelAnswer: Thank you for your letter of 10 November. We have reviewed the marks and do not agree that 'Zorvyx' is confusingly similar to our client's registered mark, but we take the concern seriously. We propose a call to discuss the goods, markets and any coexistence terms. This letter is written without prejudice and without admission of liability. Please respond by 24 November.
tasks.reasoning: A good reply is measured, preserves the position and invites dialogue.
tasks.mistake: Admitting liability too early weakens the position.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Missed Renewal
caseStudy.background: A company forgot to renew its main trademark. A competitor filed first and the company paid 400,000 to buy back the rights.
caseStudy.constraints: Rights were held by different teams.
caseStudy.solution: Lexora introduced a central docket with 12-month reminders.
